title: Programmable protein stabilization with language model-derived peptide guides.
authors: Hong, Lauren; Ye, Tianzheng; Wang, Tian Z; Srijay, Divya; Liu, Howard; Zhao, Lin; Watson, Rio; Vincoff, Sophia; Chen, Tianlai; Kholina, Kseniia; Goel, Shrey; DeLisa, Matthew P; Chatterjee, Pranam
one_liner_zh: 该文利用语言模型设计肽段引导的蛋白去泛素化酶实现靶向蛋白稳定，核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与降解调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dysregulated protein degradation via the ubiquitin-proteasomal pathway can induce numerous disease phenotypes, including cancer, neurodegeneration, and diabetes. While small molecule-based targeted protein degradation (TPD) and targeted protein stabilization (TPS) platforms can address this dysregulation, they rely on structured and stable binding pockets, which do not exist to classically "undruggable" targets. Here, we expand the TPS target space by engineering "deubiquibodies" (duAbs) via fusion of computationally-designed peptide binders to the catalytic domain of the potent OTUB1 deubiquitinase. In human cells, duAbs effectively stabilize exogenous and endogenous proteins in a DUB-dependent manner. Using protein language models to generate target-binding peptides, we engineer duAbs to conformationally diverse target proteins, including key tumor suppressor proteins p53 and WEE1, and heavily-disordered fusion oncoproteins, such as PAX3::FOXO1. We further encapsulate p53-targeting duAbs as mRNA in lipid nanoparticles and demonstrate effective intracellular delivery, p53 stabilization, and apoptosis activation, motivating further in vivo translation.
abstract_zh: 通过泛素-蛋白酶体途径的蛋白质降解失调可诱发多种疾病表型，包括癌症、神经退行性疾病和糖尿病。尽管基于小分子的靶向蛋白质降解（TPD）和靶向蛋白质稳定（TPS）平台可以应对这种失调，但它们依赖于结构化和稳定的结合口袋，而这些在经典的“不可成药”靶标中并不存在。在此，我们通过将计算设计的肽结合剂与强效OTUB1去泛素化酶的催化结构域融合，工程化“去泛素抗体”（duAbs），从而扩展TPS靶标空间。在人类细胞中，duAbs以依赖DUB的方式有效稳定外源和内源蛋白质。利用蛋白质语言模型生成靶标结合肽，我们工程化duAbs以针对构象多样的靶蛋白，包括关键肿瘤抑制蛋白p53和WEE1，以及高度无序的融合癌蛋白，如PAX3::FOXO1。我们进一步将靶向p53的duAbs封装为mRNA于脂质纳米颗粒中，并展示有效的细胞内递送、p53稳定化和凋亡激活，为后续体内转化研究提供动力。
